summary: Coinbase-backed Base has put tokenized versions of Apple, Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon shares onchain, helping push the total tokenized stock market to $3.84B. The milestone comes amid pushback from the issuers themselves, signaling friction between onchain equity products and the traditional companies whose shares are being tokenized. It matters because it shows tokenized equities scaling on Base even as the underlying issuers resist.
reason: All three mentions map to existing shelves. Base is the actor of the announcement, so its tokenized equities storyline continues rather than starts anew. Coinbase is named only as the backer, making it a plain update with no direct action of its own. The $3.84B milestone and issuer pushback extend the ongoing tokenization-of-RWA storyline rather than opening a new one.
